name: Talmon
overview: Talmon is identified in Scripture as a porter of the temple, serving alongside others such as Shallum and Akkub in guarding the gates and thresholds of the sanctuary. His family is noted among the returning exiles who came back from Babylonian captivity with Zerubbabel, highlighting their role in reestablishing temple worship and security. The consistent mention of Talmon and his brethren in the lists of gatekeepers underscores the importance of faithful stewardship and protection of the sacred space during Israel's restoration period.
